stories.title: Nitin Gadkari announces road infrastructure projects worth ₹1 lakh crore for West Bengal
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced ₹1 lakh crore in new road projects for West Bengal, adding to ₹35,000 crore in ongoing work. He promised the state's highways would eventually match US standards. The minister noted that land acquisition has accelerated significantly under the current state administration.

stories.title: Nitin Gadkari announces Rs 1 lakh crore road projects for Bengal, promises 250-km Kolkata ring road
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced ₹1 lakh crore in new road projects for West Bengal, including a 250-km ring road for Kolkata. The Centre has already completed ₹40,000 crore in state projects, with another ₹35,000 crore currently underway. Funds will not be a constraint for development.

stories.title: Capital goods and strategic manufacturing sectors projected to generate 50 lakh jobs
stories.summary: The Capital Goods and Strategic Skill Council projects 50 lakh new jobs over the next five years. The council cited growing demand for technicians, welders and CNC operators as India increases investment in defence and shipbuilding. The projection underscores the need to prepare workers for advanced manufacturing roles.

stories.title: India to cross $1 trillion export mark by March 2027 despite proposed 25% US tariff
stories.summary: ASSOCHAM Secretary General Saurabh Sanyal said India's export growth remains resilient despite proposed 25 percent US tariffs. With exports already exceeding $500 billion and growing at 15 percent, the country maintains its $1 trillion target. Alternative markets secured through free trade agreements are expected to provide support.

stories.title: India Post targets profitability by 2030 on ₹2,632 crore funding
stories.summary: The Department of Posts is targeting 29 percent revenue growth in FY27 as part of a plan to reach profitability by 2030. The Union Cabinet approved ₹2,632 crore to modernise logistics and infrastructure. The department aims to improve efficiency across its postal operations and real estate assets.

stories.title: Infrastructure projects see cost overrun of ₹3.28 trillion in October
stories.summary: Government data for October shows 1,862 infrastructure projects have a combined cost overrun of ₹3.28 trillion. The total revised cost for these projects reached ₹38.11 trillion, up from the original estimate of ₹34.83 trillion. The report did not specify the actual number of delayed projects.

stories.title: Government approves 19,983 health infrastructure units under PM-ABHIM
stories.summary: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava announced the approval of 19,983 health infrastructure units under the PM-ABHIM scheme. The initiative aims to strengthen disease surveillance and emergency preparedness. Officials emphasised the need for a mission-mode approach to meet Sustainable Development Goals through improved inter-departmental coordination and digital health.

stories.title: Norwest sells ₹262 crore stake in Amagi
stories.summary: Norwest Venture Partners X Mauritius sold a ₹262.4 crore stake in Amagi Media Labs via a block deal. Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund and Old Bridge Capital Management were the buyers. The shares traded at a 53 percent premium to the company's IPO price.

stories.title: Thomas Cook India sets December 21 EGM for Sterling Holiday merger
stories.summary: Thomas Cook India will hold an Extraordinary General Meeting on December 21, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for its merger with Sterling Holiday Resorts. The meeting will be conducted via video conferencing. The proposal follows the company's compliance with SEBI listing regulations.

stories.title: NLMC eyes ₹1,300 crore fresh asset monetisation from BSNL and MTNL
stories.summary: The National Land Monetisation Corporation is targeting ₹1,300 crore from BSNL and MTNL assets. This follows the monetisation of over ₹9,000 crore in assets earlier this financial year. The government continues to push for unlocking value from surplus and underutilised public sector properties.

stories.title: IDBI Bank disinvestment enters crucial stage as RBI examines Fairfax, says DIPAM secretary Chawla - Moneycontrol.com
CredAble acquires 70% majority stake in intelligence regtech Reql - FinTech Futures
CredAble acquires 70% stake in Reql
stories.summary: Working capital platform CredAble has acquired a 70 percent stake in Reql, an AI-native regulatory intelligence firm. The acquisition allows CredAble to expand into the Reg-Tech sector. The platform will provide compliance and legal tools for banks, financial institutions and corporate clients.

stories.title: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises Grid Controller of India on CTUIL acquisition
stories.summary: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advised Grid Controller of India on its 100 percent acquisition of Central Transmission Utility of India from Power Grid Corporation. The initial payment is ₹73.46 crore. The move is part of a regulatory restructuring to separate transmission planning from grid connectivity functions.

stories.title: Sensex gains nearly 400 points as markets rise
stories.summary: Benchmark indices rose on Thursday, supported by IT stock gains and foreign investor participation. The Sensex and Nifty have gained 12 percent and 13 percent respectively in November. Year-to-date losses for the indices are now less than 1.5 percent as sentiment improves across Asian markets.

stories.title: Sensex extends winning run as IT stocks lead market sentiment
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks rose for the second consecutive session on Thursday, driven by IT sector gains and foreign institutional investor buying. Investors are reportedly shifting focus from US technology stocks to Indian counters. Easing concerns over potential US tariff measures also helped lift market sentiment.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty extend gains for second session
stories.summary: Indian markets saw 2,362 stocks advance on Thursday, with the Nifty IT, Realty and Metal indices leading the gains. Sugar stocks also rose following preliminary industry estimates. Despite the broader rally, 109 securities hit new 52-week lows on the National Stock Exchange.

stories.title: Nifty and Sensex rally as crude prices cool
stories.summary: Benchmark indices rallied on Wednesday as foreign investors returned and crude oil prices cooled. Jupiter Wagons gained 20 percent following the announcement of a joint venture with South Korea’s Woojin Industrial Systems. Despite the index gains, 185 securities on the NSE hit new 52-week lows.

stories.title: Sensex Today Ends 390 Points Higher | Nifty Above 25,850 | Wipro Up 4% - Equitymaster
Nifty 50 eyes biggest monthly gain in six years
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 has rebounded 12.3 percent in November, driven by falling crude oil prices and an unwinding of global AI trade positions. If the index maintains this momentum, it will mark its strongest monthly performance since April 2020. Market volatility has apparently decided to take a break.

stories.title: Six BSE 100 stocks hit 52-week highs
stories.summary: Six stocks from the BSE 100 index reached fresh 52-week highs on Thursday, reflecting the highest price levels for these companies in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the last year. Investors are currently interested.

stories.title: Global stocks climb following volatile US trading
stories.summary: Global markets rose after a period of volatile trading in the United States. Tech shares have been hit this month by investor concerns regarding whether the current boom can be sustained. The market is currently debating the longevity of the excitement.

stories.title: Wall Street recovers most early losses
stories.summary: Stocks on Wall Street closed moderately lower on Wednesday after a pullback in AI stocks eased throughout the day. The market reversed much of its earlier losses as the session progressed. The pullback eventually ran out of steam.

stories.title: Wall Street Flips From AI Euphoria to Gloom - Bloomberg
Value stocks outperform growth as volatility deepens
stories.summary: Value stocks have outperformed growth counterparts over the past year as institutional money seeks shelter from market volatility. Interactive Brokers strategist Steve Sosnick described the shift as a structural repositioning. Fund managers are moving from the thing that is not working to the thing that is.

stories.title: Fed maintains hawkish stance amid market turmoil
stories.summary: US central bank officials remain focused on inflation despite a tech-led sell-off and fears for the broader economy. The Federal Reserve continues to signal potential rate hikes. The economy is currently being asked to endure both.

stories.title: European stocks rise as US markets prepare for holiday
stories.summary: European equities climbed on Wednesday, following a recovery in US markets. Trading volumes are expected to remain thin as US markets prepare for the Thanksgiving holiday. Market players are bracing themselves for a break.

stories.title: Credit card spending jumps 20 percent in October
stories.summary: Credit card transactions in India reached Rs 2.45 lakh crore in October, a 20.1 percent increase from September. Festive-season purchases and higher payment activity drove the rise, according to Reserve Bank of India data. Consumers are participating in the economy at a higher volume.

stories.title: Government confirms UPI will remain free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that UPI will remain free for consumers, with no transaction charges for person-to-person payments. The government described the recent amendment to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act as an enabling provision for long-term sustainability. Sustainability is now a matter of policy.

stories.title: SBI schedules maintenance for November 27
stories.summary: State Bank of India will suspend UPI, ATM, and online banking services for two hours on November 27, 2026, for scheduled maintenance. The outage is set to occur between 12:45 am and 2:45 am. UPI Lite will remain available for those who plan ahead.

NSE receives RBI approval for corporate bond index futures
stories.summary: The National Stock Exchange has received a no-objection certificate from the Reserve Bank of India to introduce futures contracts on corporate bond indices. The exchange previously received similar approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India. Operational preparations are now underway.

stories.title: NSE gets RBI nod to introduce corporate bond index futures
stories.summary: The National Stock Exchange has received regulatory approval to launch futures contracts on corporate bond indices. The instrument is intended to help manage interest-rate and credit-spread risks in the fixed-income market. The exchange is preparing to introduce the new derivatives product.

stories.title: PhonePe targets 2027 IPO with $15 billion valuation
stories.summary: PhonePe has restarted plans for an initial public offering, targeting a 2027 listing with a valuation between $12 billion and $15 billion. The company is expected to file updated draft papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India soon. The IPO process has resumed.

stories.title: PhonePe resumes IPO plans for 2027 listing
stories.summary: PhonePe has resumed preparations for a 2027 IPO, aiming for a valuation between USD 12 billion and USD 15 billion. Walmart, Microsoft, and Tiger Global plan to sell shares in the secondary offering, which targets proceeds of up to USD 1.5 billion. The company is currently updating its paperwork.

stories.title: Vegapay raises $10 million in Series A funding
stories.summary: Fintech infrastructure startup Vegapay has raised $10 million in a Series A round co-led by Vertex Ventures and Prosus. The company intends to use the capital to expand its credit line offerings and launch secured credit products. The round included both primary and secondary share components.

stories.title: Finnable raises Rs 405 crore in Series C round
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based NBFC Finnable has raised Rs 405 crore in a Series C round led by Bharat Value Fund. The company provides financial products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit. Existing investors TVS Capital and MEMG Family Office increased their stakes alongside new participants in the round.

stories.title: Salt Edge and Neumetria partner on AI banking data
stories.summary: Neumetria and open banking provider Salt Edge have partnered to offer a cross-bank view of customers for AI agents and lenders. Neumetria provides a behavioural understanding layer for financial platforms, while Salt Edge supplies the underlying open banking connectivity for clients in Europe and North America.

stories.title: Turrón by Plazo expands BNPL partnership in Spain
stories.summary: Turrón by Plazo, a card-based buy now, pay later solution from ID Finance, has signed a strategic partnership with experience gift provider Wonderbox in Spain. The collaboration aims to integrate the BNPL offering into the experience gift platform for local consumers.

stories.title: NBX partners with Visa for stablecoin-linked card
stories.summary: Visa, NBX, Tieto, and IDT Finance have announced plans for a new Visa Flex Card. The product aims to provide NBX customers with a method to use different forms of money they hold. The card is designed to facilitate stablecoin-linked transactions for eligible users.

stories.title: Financial goals drive mutual fund redemptions
stories.summary: A survey of 678 mutual fund distributors by Wealthy and Monitor Deloitte found that 45% of clients redeem investments to meet financial goals, while 40% cite liquidity needs. Equity market volatility was a less common reason for redemptions than the need for cash or goal achievement.

stories.title: Missing SIP instalments do not impact credit scores
stories.summary: Missing a systematic investment plan instalment may result in bank charges for failed auto-debits, but it does not affect an investor's CIBIL score. Because SIPs are investment instructions rather than borrowing obligations, existing mutual fund units remain invested and continue to track market performance.

stories.title: Robotic surgery volume expected to rise
stories.summary: Cardiac surgeons expect robotic-assisted heart surgery procedures to increase by 40% in 2026, following 1,800 procedures in the Delhi region during 2025. With the procedure becoming more common, patients are advised to check insurance policy sub-limits and exclusions to avoid unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

stories.title: Gold loan borrowers face rising auction risks
stories.summary: Gold loans overdue by 31 to 90 days rose to 1.3% in September from 0.9% in June. A 31% drop in gold prices from January peaks has increased pressure on borrowers. Experts suggest responding to notice periods and verifying jewellery valuations to manage potential auction scenarios.

stories.title: Health insurance premiums rise with healthcare costs
stories.summary: Comprehensive health insurance is increasingly marketed as a necessity to offset rising private healthcare expenses. Policybazaar data highlights the varying premium rates currently offered by leading insurers as the industry responds to the financial burden of hospital bills and limited public health services.

stories.title: Four steps to verify broker registration
stories.summary: Fraudsters often copy genuine SEBI registration numbers to appear legitimate. Investors are advised to verify brokers through the SEBI register, the NSE directory, the Google Play store, and the SEBI Check portal before transferring any funds.

stories.title: Automatic GST registration cancellation starts December 1
stories.summary: The government will introduce automatic GST registration cancellation for businesses closing operations or transferring ownership. The process removes the previous Rs 2.5 lakh input tax credit threshold and aims to reduce departmental intervention. The change follows recommendations from the 57th GST Council meeting.

stories.title: Supreme Court orders clearer food labelling
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed the FSSAI to include total sugars and saturated fats, alongside salt, as nutrients of concern on front-of-pack labels. The regulator must revisit threshold levels to ensure they are effective. The court deemed a four-month implementation timeline reasonable for the new regulations.

stories.title: Bullet train wheels to be manufactured in Chennai
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that high-precision wheels for India's bullet trains will be manufactured at the Ramkrishna Titagarh facility in Chennai. The government aims to produce all high-speed rail components domestically, with the minister projecting significantly reduced travel times between major cities.

stories.title: Industry body urges domestic fertiliser production
stories.summary: The Fertiliser Association of India says the country must boost domestic production and diversify raw material sources to mitigate external shocks. India imported over 10 million tonnes of urea last fiscal year. The sector remains vulnerable to global disruptions like the conflict in West Asia.

stories.title: Power sector coal supply hits 13-month high
stories.summary: The power sector's share of coal off-take reached 81% in October, the highest level in 13 months. Thermal power plants increased coal consumption due to record temperatures and deficient rains. Miners shipped 79 million tonnes of coal to the power sector during the month.

stories.title: GST outreach programme held in Erode
stories.summary: The Salem Central Excise and GST Commissionerate held an outreach programme in Erode on Wednesday to explain recent tax reforms. Officials briefed trade representatives and tax practitioners on process simplification and taxpayer facilitation measures. The reforms are now being explained to those who must follow them.

stories.title: ASCI report finds digital media leads in ad violations
stories.summary: Digital media accounted for 98 percent of advertising violations identified by the ASCI between April and September 2026. Meta platforms held a 73.4 percent share, with many ads linked to illegal betting. Of the ads reviewed, 72 percent were found to mislead consumers through dishonest claims.

research.title: AI, Automation, and Fiscal Pressure
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how automation affects public finances in countries that (i) tax labor at a higher rate than capital and (ii) fund services such as health care and education from tax revenues rather than user fees. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How LLM Agents Reshape Financial Knowledge Graphs: A Survey
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial knowledge graphs (KGs) link information across sources to support risk assessment, investment research, asset recommendations, and forecasting. Large language models (LLMs) help build these graphs by extracting relationships from text and matching entities across records. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper develops a model of maritime chokepoint closures in which interrupting a shipping passage produces losses that are not measured, or even bounded, by the value of the trade that transits it. The losses stem. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

This paper presents the techno-economic optimization of the Soroti Integrated Renewable Energy Microgrid (SIREM), a hybrid renewable system for grid-access expansion where Soroti District household grid. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
